q_va.definition: animal = class groups dogs, other mammals, birds, reptiles, invertebrates (880 images); non-animal = the rest (1120 images)

definitions.mean_r: mean of the red channel over the 4,096 pixels (values in [0, 1])
definitions.mean_g: mean of the green channel over the 4,096 pixels
definitions.mean_b: mean of the blue channel over the 4,096 pixels
definitions.luminance: mean of Y = 0.299 R + 0.587 G + 0.114 B over the pixels
definitions.contrast: standard deviation of Y over the pixels
definitions.saturation: mean over pixels of (max − min) / max of (R, G, B)
definitions.bc_r: border-ring mean minus centre mean of R; border = the 1,792 pixels within 8 px of the edge, centre = the central 32 x 32
definitions.bc_g: border-ring mean minus centre mean of G
definitions.bc_b: border-ring mean minus centre mean of B
definitions.bc_lum: border-ring mean minus centre mean of Y
definitions.bc_dist: Euclidean norm of the border − centre differences of (R, G, B)
definitions.hf_frac: share of the DFT energy of Y − mean(Y) at radius > 16 cycles per image among all non-zero frequencies

heat_maxabs_psi_wc.zlabel: max over k = 1..8 of |within-class corr(statistic, ψk)|

heat_maxabs_seba.zlabel: max over the 4 sets of |corr(statistic, SEBA vector)| (r = 4)

heat_r2_psi.zlabel: R² of ψk on the 12 image statistics (least-squares fit)

q_decod.protocol: fit on the 10,000 probe images, test on the 10,000 held-out; views centred with the probe mean and L2-normalised; ridge = closed-form one-vs-rest least squares on centred one-hot targets with intercept, one lambda per fit chosen by GCV summed over outputs; kNN = DINO protocol, k = 20, weights exp(cos/0.07), class vote
